verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair documentation question for a developer platform like GitHub Copilot, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows an interactive or runnable API explorer, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt and markdown docs files are machine-readable documentation, a related but different capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
